title: Collect required documents
description: Gather your birth certificate (original + photocopy), two certified photographs (3.5cm x 4.5cm), and the completed NIC application form (available from Grama Niladhari or downloaded from drp.gov.lk).

title: Get Grama Niladhari certification
description: Visit your local Grama Niladhari (GN) office. The GN officer will certify your application form and verify your identity.

title: Submit application at Divisional Secretariat
description: Take the certified form and all documents to your Divisional Secretariat office. Pay the normal processing fee of Rs. 200.

title: Visit DRP Head Office for One-Day Service
description: Go to the Department for Registration of Persons head office in Battaramulla with all your documents. Pay the one-day processing fee of Rs. 2000.

title: Biometric data capture
description: Your fingerprints and photograph will be captured digitally at the office.

title: Collect your NIC
description: For one-day service: collect your NIC the same day (~3 hours). For normal service: your NIC will be mailed to you within 3 months.

title: File a police complaint
description: Report the loss/damage of your NIC at the nearest police station and obtain the police report.

title: Collect required documents
description: Gather your police report, birth certificate (original + copy), two certified photographs, and a photocopy of your lost NIC (if available).

title: Get Grama Niladhari certification
description: Visit your local GN officer to certify the replacement application form.

title: Submit application at Divisional Secretariat
description: Submit all documents at your Divisional Secretariat and pay the applicable fee.

title: Obtain a Learner Permit
description: Visit your nearest DMT district office to apply for a learner permit. You must be at least 18 years old.

title: Wait 3 months holding period
description: You must hold the learner permit for at least 3 months before you can apply for the full licence.

title: Get Medical Certificate from NTMI
description: Visit the National Transport Medical Institution (NTMI) for a medical fitness examination. This is ONLY accepted from NTMI.

title: Book appointment online
description: Visit https://eservices.motortraffic.gov.lk to book your driving test appointment.

title: Attend DMT office with documents
description: Bring NIC (original + copy), birth certificate, learner permit, medical certificate, passport photos, and pay the applicable fee.

title: Pass the written test
description: Complete the computer-based test on traffic rules and road signs at the DMT office.

title: Pass the practical driving test
description: A DMT examiner will conduct the practical driving test at the DMT office grounds.

title: Collect your driving licence
description: Upon passing both tests, your licence will be issued. Check processing time at your DMT office.

title: Book renewal appointment online
description: Visit https://eservices.motortraffic.gov.lk and book a renewal appointment at your nearest DMT office.

title: Prepare renewal documents
description: Gather your current/expired driving licence and NIC (original + copy). Check if a medical certificate is needed for your case.

title: Visit DMT office on appointment date
description: Submit your documents and pay the renewal fee at the DMT district office.

title: Collect renewed licence
description: Your renewed licence is typically issued on the same day.
